description: Security Fixes - GitHub scan issues, dependency vulnerability, and Supabase RLS hardening

testingSetup.important: Dev server MUST run on localhost:3000 - Supabase auth is configured for this URL only

userStories.title: Fix URL substring sanitization in domain actions
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need to fix incomplete URL substring sanitization to prevent SSRF and URL manipulation attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix app/(user_dashboard)/dashboard/settings/domains/actions.ts - use URL parsing instead of substring checks
Domain validation rejects all variations of blocked domains (e.g., saltcore.io.evil.com, sub.saltcore.io)
userStories.technicalDetails: The current code uses .includes() for domain validation which can be bypassed. Fix approach: Parse as URL and check hostname properly.
userStories.notes: Completed. Replaced .includes() substring check with isBlockedDomain() function that uses proper DNS-style matching: exact match OR ends with '.blocked'. This blocks saltcore.io, sub.saltcore.io but allows legitimate domains like evil-saltcore.io-lookalike.com. Applied to both dashboard and legacy domain actions.

userStories.title: Fix URL sanitization in E2E test
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to fix the URL substring check in the pricing checkout test to use proper URL validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix tests/e2e/marketing-pricing-checkout.spec.ts - use URL object for comparison
Test still correctly validates Stripe checkout redirects
userStories.notes: Replaced .includes() substring checks with URL object parsing. Now uses parsedUrl.pathname for signin and parsedUrl.hostname for Stripe checkout validation.

userStories.title: Fix unsafe JWT role checks in billing webhook events RLS

Remove policy using JWT role check
Create SECURITY DEFINER function for webhook operations

userStories.notes: Created migration 20260111200000_fix_billing_webhook_events_rls.sql. Replaced auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'service_role' with TO service_role policy which properly restricts access to service role connections.

userStories.title: Fix overly permissive message UPDATE policy
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need to restrict the messages table UPDATE policy to prevent users from modifying other users' messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new migration to fix messages table UPDATE policy
Users can only update messages they sent (sender_id = auth.uid())
Read receipts (read_at) should be updateable only by the recipient
userStories.notes: Created migration 20260111200500_fix_messages_update_rls.sql. Dropped overly permissive UPDATE policies. Added: 1) 'Users can update their own messages' (sender_id = auth.uid()), 2) 'Studio members can mark received messages as read' (for recipients only), 3) 'Client users can mark received messages as read' (for recipients only).
